intentEvidence: Obsidian provides an extensible text platform and already provides integration with your notes (i.e. via Tasks). Therefore - what if plaintext was your canvas for MCQ questions, with a renderer in Obsidian?
motivation: MCQs are a good way to test and learn content, and the author wanted a plaintext canvas for MCQs that integrates with notes, unlike external tools.
problem: Existing tools for creating interactive quizzes often lack integration within personal notes or provide limited functionality for comprehensive testing.
summary: A simple quiz block format that allows users to create interactive multiple-choice quizzes directly within Obsidian notes.
